title: Evaluate lightweight cross-encoder fallbacks and multilingual sanity checks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: pick a practical, low-latency cross-encoder variant and a staged upgrade plan to improve multilingual reranking quality while keeping p95 latency under target and enabling graceful fallbacks. This ticket covers comparative selection, offline regression checks, small-scale latency experiments on Dedicated, and a canary+fallback rollout design that integrates with existing routing and cache layers. We aim to ship a repeatable process for choosing cross-encoder variants (quantized/lightweight) per locale band and an operational playbook for rollouts so product teams can enable higher-quality reranking without surprising latency regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate cross-encoder variants evaluated across English + 6 non-English locales with unified metrics (MRR@10, nDCG@10, latency p95, tail memory).
A selected default lightweight variant that improves MRR@10 by >=3% over baseline for at least 4 locales while keeping p95 inference latency increase <= 15ms on Dedicated baseline.
End-to-end canary rollout plan with automatic fallback to current model variant when latency or quality alarms breach thresholds (documented playbook).
Offline regression harness implemented and included in CI that runs a smoke suite (10k examples) for each release candidate, emitting pass/fail and top-5 regression diffs.
Clear telemetry dashboards and alert rules: per-locale MRR drift, inference p95, error rate, and backend queue length.
tasks: Define canonical evaluation set: sample 10k rerank pairs per locale band; include production traffic distribution and synthetic hard negatives.
Run comparative sweep of 5 candidate cross-encoder checkpoints (float16 and 8-bit quantized variants) measuring quality and latency on gpu-dedicated-small cluster.
Build offline regression harness in rerank-eval repo and wire to CI with nightly runs and PR gating for model swaps.
Microbenchmark latency with the real serving runtime including KV-cache priming - measure p50/p95/p99 and memory footprint.
Design canary routing policy: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback triggers (latency or quality thresholds).
Implement fallback variant routing in smart-router: if selected variant queue > threshold or p95 breach, route to low-latency variant and increment fallback metric.
Add dashboard panels (Console) for per-route/model-quality and cost delta estimates; link to rerank-quality dashboards.
Write runbook and playbook pages for SRE/PM: rollout steps, rollback criteria, troubleshooting checklist.
